_README: Per-breed subject descriptions for hero-image generation. The script (generate-breed-heroes.mjs) wraps each 'subject' in a shared photoreal/framing template, so edit only the breed-specific details here. Accuracy notes baked in for the high-risk breeds (designer mixes, merle, spots, brindle). Add new slugs here as breed pages are written.

prompts.bernedoodle: a Bernedoodle (Bernese Mountain Dog and Poodle cross) with a wavy-to-curly medium-length coat in classic tri-color markings: a black body, a white chest blaze, and rust/copper points above the eyes and on the cheeks; a fluffy teddy-bear face and floppy ears
prompts.goldendoodle: a Goldendoodle (Golden Retriever and Poodle cross) with a soft wavy-curly coat in warm apricot-gold, a rounded teddy-bear face, dark eyes and a dark nose, and floppy ears
prompts.mini-golden-retriever: a Mini Golden Retriever: a small dog closely resembling a compact Golden Retriever, with a wavy medium-length golden coat, feathered floppy ears, and a gentle warm expression
prompts.saint-berdoodle: a Saint Berdoodle (Saint Bernard and Poodle cross): a large dog with a wavy shaggy coat in mahogany-brown-and-white markings, a broad head, dark soulful eyes, and floppy ears
prompts.mini-aussie: a Miniature Australian Shepherd (Mini Aussie) with a medium-length blue-merle coat (mottled grey-and-black patches) with copper/tan points and white markings on the face and chest, semi-erect ears, and heterochromia (one blue eye, one brown eye)
prompts.pomsky: a Pomsky (Pomeranian and Siberian Husky cross): a small fluffy dog with Husky-style grey-and-white facial markings and mask, a thick double coat, bright blue eyes, and small pricked pointed ears
prompts.australian-labradoodle: an Australian Labradoodle with a uniform soft fleece coat in caramel-cream, a teddy-bear face, dark eyes and a dark nose, and floppy ears
prompts.teacup-poodle: a Teacup Poodle: a very tiny toy poodle with a dense curly apricot coat, dark round eyes, a small refined muzzle, and soft fluffy rounded grooming
prompts.mini-dachshund: a Miniature Dachshund: a very small short-legged, long-bodied dog with a smooth shiny coat in rich red, long floppy ears, and an alert friendly face, its low long silhouette clearly visible
prompts.german-shepherd: a German Shepherd Dog with the classic black-and-tan saddle coat pattern, large erect pointed ears, a black muzzle, an athletic build, and a confident noble expression
prompts.golden-mountain-dog: a Golden Mountain Dog (a Golden Retriever crossed with a Bernese Mountain Dog): a large fluffy dog whose coat is PREDOMINANTLY warm GOLDEN and light-brown like a Golden Retriever, with only SOFT, muted Bernese-style accents — a white chest blaze and faint rust markings; NOT a black-coated Bernese. The overall impression is a big golden, cream-and-brown fluffy dog, broad friendly face, dark eyes, floppy ears
prompts.toy-aussie: a Toy Australian Shepherd: a very small Aussie with a blue-merle coat (mottled grey-and-black) with copper points and white markings, a medium fluffy coat, and pale blue eyes
prompts.french-bulldog: a French Bulldog: a small muscular compact dog with a smooth fawn coat, large erect bat ears, a flat wrinkled face, a short muzzle, and dark wide-set eyes
prompts.cockapoo: a Cockapoo (Cocker Spaniel and Poodle cross): a small dog with a soft wavy coat in buff-apricot, long floppy ears, round dark eyes, and a cheerful teddy-bear face
prompts.labradoodle: a Labradoodle (Labrador Retriever and Poodle cross): a medium-large dog with a wavy shaggy coat in cream-yellow, floppy ears, a dark nose, and a friendly expression
prompts.maltipoo: a Maltipoo (Maltese and Poodle cross): a small fluffy dog with a soft white-to-cream coat, large round dark eyes, a black nose, and a sweet teddy-bear face
prompts.cavalier-king-charles-spaniel: a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel: a small toy spaniel with a soft silky medium-length coat in Blenheim chestnut-and-white, tricolor black/white/tan, black and tan, or solid ruby coloring, large round dark eyes, a sweet gentle expression, and long feathered floppy ears
prompts.cocker-spaniel: a Cocker Spaniel with a silky feathered medium-length coat in solid black or a warm honey-apricot, long floppy ears set low on the head, large dark soulful eyes, and a perpetually cheerful expression; either the American type (compact, 13-15 inches) or the English type (larger, 15-17 inches)
prompts.cavapoo: a Cavapoo (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel and Poodle cross): a small dog with a soft wavy coat in Blenheim chestnut-and-white markings, long feathered floppy ears, and large soft dark eyes
prompts.chihuahua: a Chihuahua: a tiny toy dog weighing 3-6 pounds with a small refined head, huge round dark eyes, high-set pointed ears, a long narrow muzzle, a delicate body, and a confident proud posture; coat color in fawn, cream, black, white, or tan
prompts.cane-corso: a Cane Corso: a large powerful Italian mastiff with a short sleek black coat, a broad muscular head, natural uncropped folded ears, a strong jaw, and an alert confident expression
prompts.dalmatian: a Dalmatian: an athletic short-coated pure-white dog densely covered in distinct, well-defined black spots (including spots on the face and ears), with dark eyes and an alert friendly expression
prompts.belgian-malinois: a Belgian Malinois: a square, athletic herding/working dog with a short straight coat in rich fawn-to-mahogany with a black overlay, a black mask and black ears, erect pointed ears, and an alert, intensely focused working expression
prompts.boxer: a Boxer: a muscular medium-large dog with a short, smooth, shiny coat in rich fawn or brindle with white markings, a distinctive underbite and broad muzzle, an alert forward-facing expression, and powerful well-defined musculature throughout the body
prompts.great-dane: a Great Dane: a massive elegant working dog with a short, smooth, glossy coat in fawn, brindle, black, harlequin (white with black patches), or mantle (black with white markings), standing at least 30 inches tall at the shoulder, weighing up to 175 pounds, with a long neck, broad deep chest, elegant proportions, alert pointed ears, and a calm, dignified, gentle expression
prompts.maltese: a Maltese: a small toy companion dog entirely covered in a long, straight, silky pure-white coat falling to the floor, dark round eyes, a small black nose, and a confident, alert expression
prompts.bernese-mountain-dog: a Bernese Mountain Dog: a large sturdy tricolor dog with a jet-black body, a white blaze down the face and a white chest marking, rust-colored points on the cheeks, legs, and eyebrows, a thick long double coat, floppy ears, and a gentle, calm expression
prompts.vizsla: a Vizsla: a lean, athletic, short-coated hunting dog with a sleek golden-rust coat, a lean muscular build, medium floppy ears, an alert pointing stance, and warm expressive eyes
prompts.chocolate-lab: a Chocolate Labrador Retriever: a sturdy, athletic sporting dog entirely covered in a short, dense, solid rich chocolate-brown coat, with warm amber-brown eyes, a broad head, floppy ears, and a friendly, eager expression
prompts.mini-french-bulldog: a Mini French Bulldog: a noticeably small, compact bulldog with a smooth fawn coat, large erect bat ears, a flat wrinkled face, and dark wide-set eyes — proportioned like a standard French Bulldog but visibly smaller in scale
prompts.giant-schnauzer: a Giant Schnauzer: a large, square-built working dog with a wiry black double coat, a thick bushy beard and heavy arched eyebrows, cropped or natural folded ears, and an alert, watchful expression
prompts.newfoundland: a Newfoundland: a massive, heavy-boned working dog with a thick water-resistant solid black double coat, a broad head with a gentle, slightly mournful expression, small floppy ears, and a powerful, deep-chested build
prompts.american-bully: an American Bully: a stocky, heavily muscled companion dog with a short smooth glossy brindle coat, a broad blocky head, a wide deep chest, thick low-set legs, and a confident, friendly expression
prompts.agouti-husky: a Siberian Husky with a rare agouti (wolf-sable) coat: dense fur with individual hairs banded in black, tan, and grey giving a mottled wild wolf-like appearance, a dark facial mask with tan spectacle markings around piercing eyes, erect triangular ears, and an alert expression
prompts.poodle: a Standard Poodle with a dense, tightly curled solid black or apricot coat groomed in a neat, natural pet trim, a long refined muzzle, dark alert eyes, and long pendant ears with curly fringe
prompts.australian-shepherd: an Australian Shepherd with a medium-length blue-merle coat (mottled grey-and-black patches) with copper/tan points and white markings on the face, chest, and legs, semi-erect triangular ears, a natural bobtail or docked tail, and one blue eye and one brown eye
prompts.golden-retriever: a Golden Retriever with a dense, wavy, water-repellent double coat in warm honey-gold, feathered ears and tail, dark friendly eyes, a broad head, and an open panting grin
prompts.labrador-retriever: a Labrador Retriever with a short, dense, water-resistant double coat in solid yellow, a broad head, an otter-like tail, floppy ears, and an alert, eager expression
prompts.siberian-husky: a Siberian Husky with a thick double coat in black-and-white markings, a well-defined dark facial mask, erect triangular ears, striking pale blue eyes, and an alert, mischievous expression
prompts.dachshund: a Dachshund: a long-bodied, short-legged hound with a smooth shiny coat in rich red, long floppy ears, a confident alert stance, and an inquisitive expression
prompts.aussiedoodle: an Aussiedoodle (Australian Shepherd and Poodle cross): a medium fluffy dog with a wavy blue-merle coat (mottled grey-and-black patches) with copper points and white markings on the face and chest, semi-erect ears, and one blue eye and one brown eye
prompts.sheepadoodle: a Sheepadoodle (Old English Sheepdog and Poodle cross): a large shaggy dog with a dense wavy-to-curly coat in a black-and-white 'panda' pattern, a fringe partly covering the eyes, floppy ears, and a big-hearted, clownish expression
prompts.corgi: a Pembroke Welsh Corgi: a small long-bodied herding dog with short stubby legs, a medium-length double coat in red-and-white, large erect triangular ears, a fox-like face, and an alert, confident expression
prompts.shih-tzu: a Shih Tzu: a small toy companion dog with a long flowing double coat in gold-and-white, a round broad head, large dark round eyes, a short pushed-up nose, and a plumed tail carried over the back
prompts.yorkshire-terrier: a Yorkshire Terrier: a tiny toy terrier with a long, straight, silky floor-length coat parted down the spine in steel-blue and rich tan, a compact confident frame, small V-shaped ears, dark alert eyes, and a bold terrier expression
prompts.pomeranian: a Pomeranian: a small fluffy Spitz-type toy dog with a thick double coat standing straight out from the body in vivid orange, a fox-like face, small pricked triangular ears, dark bright eyes, and a plumed tail carried flat over the back
prompts.rottweiler: a Rottweiler: a large powerful working dog with a short dense black double coat and distinctive rust-mahogany markings on the face above the eyes, cheeks, legs, and chest, a broad muscular head, triangular pendant ears, a confident alert gaze, and a solid athletic build
prompts.beagle: a Beagle: a compact sturdy hunting hound with a short dense coat in classic tricolor (jet black, pure white, and tan/rust points on the face and legs), long floppy ears hanging close to the ground, an alert friendly expression, upright triangular eyes, and a compact athletic build
prompts.border-collie: a Border Collie: a medium-sized herding dog with an intense focused gaze, a medium-length double coat in black-and-white (the most common pattern), upright alert ears, a lean athletic muscular build, and an expression of total concentration and intelligence
prompts.pug: a Pug: a small toy companion dog with a smooth shiny short coat in fawn with a black mask, a distinctive flat wrinkled face, a pushed-in muzzle, large dark eyes set low and wide apart, a compact stocky body, and a characteristic dignified, slightly bemused expression
prompts.shiba-inu: a Shiba Inu: a small Japanese Spitz-type dog with a compact muscular frame, a medium-length double coat in red with white urajiro markings, a curled tail carried over the back, small triangular pricked ears, dark alert eyes, and a characteristically dignified, slightly unimpressed expression
prompts.samoyed: a Samoyed: a large fluffy Arctic sled dog with a thick dense pure-white double coat, a broad gentle head, dark round eyes that convey a perpetual smile, small folded triangular ears with white fur fringe, a plumed tail carried over the back, and an overall expression of warm amiability and intelligence
